column3: `Club_Records::update_league_position_records(league, all_time)`: sorts the table of each league stage and stores each club's best and worst league position for the season and, with the second argument, all time (queueing the news item for a human club or national side). \n A null league, or one whose stage index (`stage_index()`) is not `stage_index::MAIN`, gives the error boxes and 0. In each league of the chain (`league_stage_chain`) it sorts the table (`exe::league_sort_table`) and, for each row that has games (`played()`) and a club, through the season records (`club_season_record`) and the all-time records (`club_all_time_record`, created when missing): best position (type 1, `exe::club_records_record_type_applies`) and worst (type 2). The position is written when there is no record yet (−1), when the competition (the id of the first league) has a higher reputation (best) or a lower one (worst), or when it is the same competition with a better or worse position: it stores the position (+0 / `club_record::WORST_POSITION`), the competition (`club_record::BEST_POSITION_COMP` / `club_record::WORST_POSITION_COMP`) and the year (`club_record::BEST_POSITION_YEAR` / `club_record::WORST_POSITION_YEAR`; 0 for the season, `exe::key_nation_get_club_season_year` for all time). For all time (with `always`; an id above [`G_CLUB_COMP_COUNT`] also counts as "no record"), the news queue (`club_records_queue_record_news`). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::send_record_news()` (SEH frame without a destructor): delivers the news item of each queued record (human club or national side) and empties the queue. \n Without a queue (`club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE`), returns 1. For each record in the queue (6 bytes: club id, type at `record_news_item::RECORD_TYPE`, period at `record_news_item::PERIOD`) of a human club (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`) or a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`): the news item 0x3e8 (local) is filled by `exe::club_records_write_record_news_fields` with the season record (period 2, `club_season_record`) or the all-time record (`club_all_time_record`), without creating them; it is delivered to the nation (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`) of the national side or to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`). A queue with capacity (`club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE_CAPACITY`) of 100 or more is freed (`exe::crt_free`) and `NEWS_QUEUE`/`NEWS_QUEUE_CAPACITY` are zeroed. The count (`club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE_COUNT`) goes back to 0. Returns 1.

`Club_Records::pick_fans_player_of_year(club, record)`: picks the fans' player of the year from the club's squad: the best score among the players with games above the minimum; stores his reference at `club_record::FANS_PLAYER` of the record and returns 1, or 0. \n Without games (signed `club_record_entry::SEASON_GAMES` of the club's 106-byte entry in [this + `club_records_fields::CLUB_ENTRIES`]) and with reputation (`reputation()`) below 3000, returns 0. With the factor 0.6, falling by 0.1 (`rdata::F64_0_1`) while nobody has been chosen and it is above 0.2 (`rdata::F64_0_2`): the minimum number of games is `SEASON_GAMES` × factor (`ftol`); among the 50 squad slots (`squad()`), the players (`player()`, id below [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]) of the club (`club_job()`) with statistic 6 (`exe::playerstats_get_category_record` over [`G_PLAYER_STATS`]) whose games are above 0 and above the minimum (signed 16 bits), the one with the highest score (`fan_rating`: average + 0.025 × +2 + 1/60 × +6, club and player likes; it must be above −1000). Nobody: 0; otherwise his reference (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`) at `club_record::FANS_PLAYER` of the record and 1.

`Club_Records::update_transfer_fee_records(transfer)`: updates the buyer's paid record and the seller's received record, for the season and all time (fee, reference, other club, date, loan). \n The person (`target_staff_id()`) and the buying club (`buyer_club_id()`); the person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract` over [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], kept in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]) gives the seller (`club()`). The buyer's season (`exe::club_records_get_season_record`) and all-time (`exe::club_records_get_all_time_record`) records are fetched (created when missing); without a seller, returns 1. A fee (`fee()`) above the season paid record (`club_record::FEE_PAID`) becomes the record: the fee, the person's reference (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`, at `FEE_PAID_HOLDER`), the seller (`FEE_PAID_OTHER_CLUB_ID`), today's date (`FEE_PAID_DATE`) and the loan flag (`FEE_PAID_FLAG`: `exchange_players()` ≠ 0); if it is above the all-time record it is copied there, and if it passes 1000 × (reputation + 300) (`is_big_transfer`): the record goes to the news queue (`exe::club_records_queue_record_news`, 0x1c, if it is not there yet) and the manager (`chairman()`) comes to favour the person (`exe::staff_add_favoured_staff`, forced). The same for the seller in the received record (`club_record::FEE_RECEIVED`; the queue with 0x1d, without the favouring). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::add_transfer_totals(fee, buyer, seller)`: adds the fee to the seller's season income and the buyer's season spending, raises the all-time records and queues the record news (0x1f, 0x1e) above (`reputation()` + 500) × 1000. \n The seller adds `value` to the income for the season (`club_record::TRANSFER_INCOME` of the season record `exe::club_records_get_season_record`; −1 = nothing yet: the fee is stored) and zeroes the year (`club_record::TRANSFER_INCOME_YEAR`); above the all-time record (`exe::club_records_get_all_time_record`, same field), the record becomes the season one with the club's season year (`exe::key_nation_get_club_season_year`), and with the total at least (club `reputation()` + 500) × 1000 and the year different from the record's, the record news item 0x1f (`exe::club_records_queue_record_news`) if it is not in the queue yet. The buyer does the same for spending (`club_record::TRANSFER_SPENDING`, year `club_record::TRANSFER_SPENDING_YEAR`, news 0x1e), but the minimum is checked against the OLD record and without the year. The records are created when missing (second argument 1). A null buyer or seller: nothing, 1. Returns 1.

`club_records_update_career_records(player, club, games, goals)`: updates the club's all-time league appearances (+0x247) and goals (+0x261) records, with the player reference (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`), when the record type applies to the club (`exe::club_records_record_type_applies`). \n In the club's all-time records (`exe::club_records_get_all_time_record`, created when missing), if type 0x17 applies to the club (`exe::club_records_record_type_applies`) and `games` beats the record (+0x247; −1 = no record), the record = `games` and the player's reference goes to +0x249 (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`); the same with type 0x18 and `goals` (+0x261, reference +0x263). Returns 1. A null player or club, or no record: the "Error" box (lines 0x6fa and 0x702) and 0.

`Club_Records::update_season_rating_record(club)`: the squad player with the best average rating (statistic 0x11) among those who played at least half the games becomes the season rating record. \n With games in the season (byte `club_record_entry::SEASON_GAMES` of the club's entry, [this + `club_records_fields::CLUB_ENTRIES`] + id × 0x6a) and the season record (`exe::club_records_get_season_record`, without creating), the record rating (`club_record::SEASON_RATING`) goes back to −1.0 and, over the 50 squad slots (`squad()`), the player (not a human manager: id < [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]) with statistics (`player()`) at the club (`club_job()` = the club or the one linked to it, `exe::club_get_linked_b_team`) and a season statistics record (`exe::playerstats_get_category_record`, type 6) who played at least half the games (statistic 1, truncated, `exe::player_stats_get_record_value` with 6.5) and has the highest average (statistic 0x11) becomes the record: the rating (`SEASON_RATING`, float), the games (`club_record::SEASON_RATING_GAMES`), the reference (`SEASON_RATING` + 4, `exe::fill_staff_name_ref`) and `club_record::SEASON_RATING_YEAR` = 0. Returns 1 if someone became the record. Without games or without a record: 0. A null club: the original routine (box 0x16f2, 0).

`Club_Records::get_all_time_record(club, create)`: returns the club's all-time records: index +0 of its entry ([this + `club_records_fields::CLUB_ENTRIES`] + id × 0x6a, `club_records_entry`) into the vector [this + `club_records_fields::ALL_TIME_RECORDS`] of 0x38b-byte records. \n Without an index (−1) and with `create`: the new index is the count (`club_records_fields::ALL_TIME_COUNT`, which goes up), the vector grows by 50 at a time (capacity `club_records_fields::ALL_TIME_CAPACITY`, realloc `exe::crt_realloc`; without memory, box 0x1694 and the end, `records_out_of_memory`) and the record is reset (`exe::season_history_entry_clear`). Returns the record, or 0 without an index. A null club: the original routine (box 0x1680, 0).

`Club_Records::get_season_record(club, create)`: the same as `get_all_time_record` for the season records: index +4 of the entry, vector [this + `club_records_fields::SEASON_RECORDS`], capacity `club_records_fields::SEASON_CAPACITY`, count `club_records_fields::SEASON_COUNT` (without memory, box 0x16c9 and the end). A null club: the original routine (box 0x16b5, 0).

`Club_Records::queue_record_news(id, type)`: appends (club id at +0, record type at `record_news_item::RECORD_TYPE`; byte +5 is left as it is) to the 6-byte vector [this + `club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE`] of record news, read by `send_record_news`. \n When full (count `club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE_COUNT` = capacity `club_records_fields::NEWS_QUEUE_CAPACITY`) it grows by 5 at a time (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`); without memory, box 0x174f and returns 0 (the game goes on, without the vector). Returns 1.

`Club_Records::offer_breaks_fee_record(offer, require)`: tells whether the offer fee (`fee()`) beats the fee-paid record of the buying club (`buyer_club_id()`; the all-time records through `exe::club_records_get_all_time_record`, creating them if needed). \n It must be at least 50 × reputation (`reputation()`) + 500,000; with `exigir`, also at least reputation² × the constant `rdata::F64_0_1` (`ftol`); and above zero and above the record (`club_record::FEE_PAID`). A null offer: 0.

`transfer_fee_record_construct`: constructs the highest transfer fee paid record: the dates at `transfer_fee_record::HOLDER_DATE` and `transfer_fee_record::DATE` (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`). \n The original's SEH frame only covers the 2nd date (`exe::date_date_54a110` does not fail). Returns `this`.
constructs the highest fee received record: the dates at `transfer_fee_record::HOLDER_DATE` and `transfer_fee_record::DATE` (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`)

constructs the goals in a match record: the holder date (`goals_in_match_record::HOLDER_DATE`) and the match date (`goals_in_match_record::MATCH`) (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`)
constructs the youngest player record: the age (+0), the holder date (`age_record::HOLDER_DATE`) and the match date (`age_record::MATCH_DATE`) (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`)

`oldest_player_record_construct`: constructs the oldest player record: the age (+0), the record holder's date (`age_record::HOLDER_DATE`) and the match date (`age_record::MATCH_DATE`) (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`). \n The original's SEH frame is not needed (`exe::date_date_54a110` does not fail). Returns `this`.
copies the rating record (0x1f bytes): the rating (+0), the holder (`rating_record::HOLDER`, through `assign_record_holder`), `rating_record::GAMES` and `rating_record::YEAR`
copies the man of the match record (0x1b bytes): the count (+0), the holder (`man_of_match_record::HOLDER`, through `assign_record_holder`) and the year (`man_of_match_record::YEAR`)

copies the discipline record (0x1c bytes): yellows (+0), reds (`club_discipline_record::RED_CARDS`), the holder (`club_discipline_record::HOLDER`, through `assign_record_holder`) and the year (`club_discipline_record::YEAR`)
copies the count record (0x1a bytes): the count (+0, word) and the holder (`count_record::HOLDER`, through `exe::record_holder_assign`)
copies the fans player record (0x1a bytes): the holder (+0, through `exe::record_holder_assign`) and the year (`fans_player_record::YEAR`)
constructs the tally record: the holder date at `tally_record::HOLDER_DATE` (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`)
constructs the count record: the holder date at `count_record::HOLDER_DATE` (`exe::date_date_54a110`, through `init_default_date`)

`transfer_fee_record_assign`: copies the transfer fee record (0x29 bytes) from `source`: five dwords (+0..+0x10: the fee, the player, the other club...), the date at `transfer_fee_record::HOLDER_DATE`, the dword `transfer_fee_record::OTHER_CLUB_ID`, the date at `transfer_fee_record::DATE` and the part-exchange flag (`transfer_fee_record::FLAG`). Returns `this`.

`goals_in_match_record_assign`: copies the goals-in-a-match record (0x38 bytes) from `source`: the goals (+0, byte), the record holder at `goals_in_match_record::HOLDER` (`exe::record_holder_assign`) and the match record at `goals_in_match_record::MATCH` (`exe::match_record_assign`, both already in Rust). Returns `this`.

Copies the match record (0x1f bytes) from `source`: the date, the opponent, the score and the fixture fields. \n The date at +0 (`copy_record_date`), then +8 (dword), `club_match_record::ROUND_PREFIX` and `club_match_record::ROUND_NAME` (words), `club_match_record::VENUE` (byte), `club_match_record::CLUB_ID` and `club_match_record::OPPONENT_ID` (dwords), `club_match_record::GOALS_FOR` and `club_match_record::GOALS_AGAINST` (bytes) and `club_match_record::MATCH_STATS_SLOT` (dword). Returns `this`.
builds the record holder: only the date at `record_holder::DATE` (`exe::date_date_54a110`)

Counts the results in the national side's history between two months (year × 12 + month), from the end, for the work permit. \n Ret 0x14: `FIFA_RANKINGS::count_results_in_period(nation, month_from, year_from, month_to, year_to)` (used by the work permit `is_work_permit_granted`, with the two years up to today): in the nation's entry (id `[nation]`, 0x2c bytes in table `[this]`), the history (+4, 5-byte entries: points, month +2, year +3; count `fifa_ranking_entry::HISTORY_COUNT`) from the end to the start; a year × 12 + month before the start of the period stops the search, up to the end of the period each one counts. In 16 bits. TapeCall on every permit that reaches the national side matches: no counter.

Updates the FIFA rankings on the 18th: drops the results older than a year, sorts the histories, rolls the yearly totals and redoes scores and positions. \n Ret 4: `FIFA_RANKINGS::update_rankings(date)` (from the national sides' day `national_teams_daily_update`): only on the 18th (`exe::date_get_day_of_month`). Stores the date in +5 (`exe::date_operator_3d`) and, in each nation (`[G_NATION_COUNT]` entries), removes from the history the results older than a year (year + 1 before today's, or the same year with the month before today's, `exe::date_get_month`), putting the last one in its place; the loop goes from the low byte of the count (`fifa_ranking_entry::HISTORY_COUNT`) − 1 down to 0, as in the original. Then sorts the history by points (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_result_points_desc`). In the month stored in +4, with the year different from `[G_GAME_START_DATE_YEAR]`, the yearly totals move one slot (`fifa_ranking_entry::YEAR_TOTALS` → +0x28) and `YEAR_TOTALS` is zeroed. Finally the scores (`exe::fifa_rankings_recalculate_scores`) and the positions: the order (`exe::fifa_rankings_collect_ranked_order`) gives position + 1 in `fifa_ranking_entry::POSITION`, with the previous one in `fifa_ranking_entry::PREVIOUS_POSITION`; the order vector is freed (`exe::crt_free`).

Returns the national side's strength tier from 1 to 4, by reputation and ranking position. \n Ret 4: `FIFA_RANKINGS::get_nation_strength_tier(nation)` (twice per international result `exe::fifa_rankings_record_match_result`): reputation (`reputation()`) below 3000 and position (`fifa_ranking_entry::POSITION` of the entry, `ranking_entry`) below 50: 3; reputation below 6000 and position below 15: 2; otherwise by position: below 21, 1; below 61, 2; below 101, 3; else 4.

Recalculates the scores: the year total from the best eight results and the score from the totals of this year and the five before. \n `FIFA_RANKINGS::recalculate_scores()` (from the update of the 18th `update_rankings`): in each nation, the sum of the points of the first eight results (the history comes sorted) and that of all; with more than eight, the year total (`fifa_ranking_entry::YEAR_TOTALS`) is (all × 8 / count + eight) / 2, otherwise the eight. If the date of `[G_GAME_START_DATE]` is after today (`G_CURRENT_DATE`) minus 365 days (`exe::date_sub_days`), with fewer than nine results (`fifa_ranking_entry::HISTORY_COUNT`) the total is (+0x18 + eight) / (count + 8) × 8 (with no results, +0x18). The score (`fifa_ranking_entry::SCORE`, f32): (`YEAR_TOTALS` + 5/6 of +0x18 + 4/6 of +0x1c + 3/6 of +0x20 + 2/6 of +0x24 + 1/6 of +0x28, each part truncated) × `rdata::F64_0_001`.

Returns a new array with the ranking entries of the nations that have a national side, sorted by score, and the count. \n Ret 4: `FIFA_RANKINGS::collect_ranked_order(&count)` (from the update of the 18th `update_rankings` and from the ranking screen): a vector (`exe::crt_malloc`) of `[G_NATION_COUNT]` pointers; without it, the "Error" box (line 0x1e3) and 0, without storing the count. The table entries (0x2c bytes) of the nations with a national side (`nation::CONTINENT` of the nation, `nation::SIZE`-byte records in `[G_NATION_TABLE]`), sorted by score (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_ranking_score_desc`); the count goes in `count`.

Creates the initial FIFA ranking table. Rule: each nation's points are its database strength ÷ 35, repeated as the points of each of the 6 years [inference] (× 1000); the position comes from the points order. \n Ret 0, `FIFA_RANKINGS::create_default_table`: the initial FIFA ranking table (0x2c-byte records, one per nation, calloc `exe::crt_calloc` of `[G_NATION_COUNT]` × 0x2c in +0; out of memory: the box at line 0x2da). Each record: +0 the nation index; the nation's strength (`nation::FIFA_COEFFICIENT`, double, 0x122-byte nations in `[G_NATION_TABLE]`) × 1/35 (`rdata::F64_0_02857142857`) gives the points (`fifa_ranking_entry::SCORE`, float) and, × 1000 (`rdata::F64_1000`, truncated), the 6 dwords `fifa_ranking_entry::YEAR_TOTALS`..+0x28 [inference: the points of each of the last years]. Then the order by points (`exe::fifa_rankings_collect_ranked_order`(this, &count), thiscall, the sorted list of the nations with a continent) gives the position: `fifa_ranking_entry::PREVIOUS_POSITION` = the previous position (`fifa_ranking_entry::POSITION`) and `POSITION` = 1, 2, 3...; the list is freed.

The NSL finals series: the top six of the regular season play their own round-robin stage (with the league points and tie-breakers) and its top two go to the grand final; sends the draw news. \n `AusNsl::create_finals_series_stage()` (SEH frame only for the new), called at the end of the regular season. 1) The top six of the league table (rows 0 to 5, in order, `aus_nsl_table_row_club`) in a local vector of 6. 2) The round table through virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (create_round_table: thiscall(this, 0, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10). 3) The stage: operator new `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) and the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE` (thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments, in the original's order: the league, 6, the vector, 1, `competition()`, the round table, the rounds (word), the points `win_points()` and `draw_points()`, the category `match_category()`, &`league::TIEBREAKS`, &{2,0,0,0} (two top places: the two who go to the grand final), the year `year()` (word), 0, the extra (word), `importance()`, 1, 0, `league_flags()` (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes clean values). Out of memory: 0. 4) `stages()`[0] = the stage and the round table freed (free `exe::crt_free`). No stage: the error box at line 0x328 and 0. With it: the draw news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news` on the stage, thiscall, ret 0), `set_current_stage(0)` and 1. \n [inference] The finals series is a short league of the six; its top two go to the grand final. The real NSL used a double-chance knockout.

The NSL grand final: the top two of the finals series in a two-club cup stage; the winner is the Australian champion. \n `AusNsl::create_grand_final_stage()` (SEH frame only for the new), called at the end of the finals series: the top two of the finals series table (`stages()`[0], rows 0 and 1, in that order, `aus_nsl_table_row_club`) in a list of 2 (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 8; out of memory: the error box at line 0x348 and return); the round table through virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (thiscall(this, 1, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10); the stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2) and the Cup_Stage constructor `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, 2, the list, the rounds, `competition()`, the table, the year `year()`, 1, 1, the extra, 0x14, 0, 0, 0 and null seeds; the copy passes clean words) into `stages()`[1] and the table freed (free `exe::crt_free`). No stage: the error box at line 0x35c and return (without freeing the list). With it: Cup::set_up_round (`exe::cup_set_up_round`, thiscall(stage, 0), ret 4) and the list freed. The current stage (+0x30 = 1) was already written by the next stage. \n [inference] The grand final is a single game, with the finals series winner as the home side.

`AusNsl::create_table()`: the Australian NSL has 13 clubs (`is_in_division`: +0x57 = [`KEY_CLUB_COMP_AUSTRALIAN_NATIONAL_SOCCER_LEAGUE`]), those of the division in database order, until it is full (the counter in an int, compared as a word). \n Not full: the error box at line 0x252 and 0; full: 1, with no prize fund nor TV money. Source 0x987c20 (the out-of-memory box at line 0x241, `alloc_league_table`).

The Minas Gerais final: the winners of the first and second halves meet over two games [inference: home and away], the first-half winner as seed 0; if the same club wins both halves, it is champion without a final. 
 `BraRegMinasGerais::create_final_stage()`, called from the next stage when the second half ends. The two half winners (the club in the first row of each League_Stage's table, `half_champion`) go into a list of 2 (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 8; out of memory: the error box at line 0x226 and return). 
 - The same club in both halves: it is champion without a final. `set_current_stage(1)`, `set_stage_count(2)` (the season ends with the two stages), status 5 (`league_table_row::STATUS`, `table_status::CHAMPIONS`) in the first row of each half's table and in its row of the league table (`table()`, the `club_count()` rows). The list is not freed (the original leaks it; so does the copy). 
 - Different winners: the final, over two games [inference: home and away]. Virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (create_round_table: thiscall(this, stage 2, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10) builds the round table; the new stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new` of 0xb2; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, 2, the list, the rounds, `competition()`, the table, the year `year()`, 2, 1, the extra, 0x14, 0, 1, 0 and the seeds {0, 1}: the first-half winner is seed 0) goes into the third stage slot (`stages()` + 8; no stage: the error box at line 0x250 and return, without freeing). With it: Cup::set_up_round (`exe::cup_set_up_round`, thiscall(stage, 0), ret 4), the table and the list freed (free `exe::crt_free`, in that order) and `set_current_stage(2)`. The original's SEH frame covers only the constructor (no destructor).

The end of the Minas Gerais season: with a final, the honours come from the final; without one, from the league, and the champion gets 350,000 and the runner-up 100,000 in prize money. Then, once the twelve state leagues are over, the champions go into the Champions Cup. 
 `BraRegMinasGerais::record_season_honours()` (slot 13). 
 - With a final (`current_stage()` = 2): the history of the final (slot 13, `comp_vtable::RECORD_SEASON_HONOURS`, of stage `stages()` + 8) and then, as a tail jump, `exe::bra_nat_first_fill_champions_cup_entrants` (cdecl with no arguments: when the twelve state leagues are over, it puts the champions into the Champions Cup); returns its eax. 
 - Without a final (the same champion in both halves): the league history (League::record_season_honours `FN_LEAGUE_RECORD_SEASON_HONOURS`, thiscall, ret 0); the prizes, 350,000 to the champion (first row of table `table()`) and 100,000 to the runner-up (second row), each one to the balance (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` on [`G_FINANCE_TABLE`] -> the club's finances, thiscall, ret 4; `exe::finance_add_prize_money` Finance::add_prize_money, thiscall, ret 4) and in the prize money news (`exe::comp_send_prize_money_news` Comp::send_prize_money_news: thiscall(this, club, 64-bit amount, position 1 or 2, round 0, match 0, type −2), ret 0x1c); then `exe::bra_nat_first_fill_champions_cup_entrants`, as above.

The Rio de Janeiro final: the winners of the first and second halves meet over two games [inference: home and away], the first-half winner as seed 0; if the same club wins both halves, it is champion without a final. 
 `BraRegRio::create_final_stage()`, called from the next stage when the second half ends. The two half winners (the club in the first row of each League_Stage's table, `half_champion`) go into a list of 2 (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 8; out of memory: the error box at line 0x226 and return). 
 - The same club in both halves: it is champion without a final. `set_current_stage(1)`, `set_stage_count(2)` (the season ends with the two stages), status 5 (`league_table_row::STATUS`, `table_status::CHAMPIONS`) in the first row of each half's table and in its row of the league table (`table()`, the `club_count()` rows). The list is not freed (the original leaks it; so does the copy). 
 - Different winners: the final, over two games [inference: home and away]. Virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (create_round_table: thiscall(this, stage 2, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10) builds the round table; the new stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new` of 0xb2; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, 2, the list, the rounds, `competition()`, the table, the year `year()`, 2, 1, the extra, 0x14, 0, 1, 0 and the seeds {0, 1}: the first-half winner is seed 0) goes into the third stage slot (`stages()` + 8; no stage: the error box at line 0x250 and return, without freeing). With it: Cup::set_up_round (`exe::cup_set_up_round`, thiscall(stage, 0), ret 4), the table and the list freed (free `exe::crt_free`, in that order) and `set_current_stage(2)`. The original's SEH frame covers only the constructor (no destructor).

The end of the Rio de Janeiro (Carioca) season: with a final, the honours come from the final; without one, from the league, and the champion gets 675,000 and the runner-up 250,000 in prize money. Then, once the twelve state leagues are over, the champions go into the Champions Cup. 
 `BraRegRio::record_season_honours()` (slot 13). 
 - With a final (`current_stage()` = 2): the history of the final (slot 13, `comp_vtable::RECORD_SEASON_HONOURS`, of stage `stages()` + 8) and then, as a tail jump, `exe::bra_nat_first_fill_champions_cup_entrants` (cdecl with no arguments: when the twelve state leagues are over, it puts the champions into the Champions Cup); returns its eax. 
 - Without a final (the same champion in both halves): the league history (League::record_season_honours `FN_LEAGUE_RECORD_SEASON_HONOURS`, thiscall, ret 0); the prizes, 675,000 to the champion (first row of table `table()`) and 250,000 to the runner-up (second row), each one to the balance (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` on [`G_FINANCE_TABLE`] -> the club's finances, thiscall, ret 4; `exe::finance_add_prize_money` Finance::add_prize_money, thiscall, ret 4) and in the prize money news (`exe::comp_send_prize_money_news` Comp::send_prize_money_news: thiscall(this, club, 64-bit amount, position 1 or 2, round 0, match 0, type −2), ret 0x1c); then `exe::bra_nat_first_fill_champions_cup_entrants`, as above.

Creates the La Primera table of 20 clubs; first the clubs of the Spanish lower division move to the generic lower division; prize fund of 250,000 per place; TV pays 5,000,000 to each club. \n `SpaFirst::create_table()`. `set_club_count(20)` and the table (`set_table`, malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 0x49c; out of memory: the box with source 0xa82844, line 0x250, and 0). Before filling, the clubs of the Spanish lower division ([`KEY_CLUB_COMP_SPANISH_LOWER_DIVISION`]) move to the generic lower division (`club::DIVISION` = the record of [`KEY_CLUB_COMP_A_LOWER_DIVISION`], `comp_record_of`). Then the Primera clubs ([`KEY_CLUB_COMP_SPANISH_FIRST_DIVISION`]) in database order, each in the next row (League::init_table_row `exe::league_init_table_row`: thiscall(league, row, club, 0, 0), ret 0x10), until full (not filled: 0). Full: the prize fund (`set_prize_fund` with League::calc_prize_fund `exe::league_calc_prize_fund` with the share of 250,000), `set_prize_mode(1)`, the TV money of 5,000,000 to each club (`exe::league_pay_tv_rights`: thiscall(league, value, 0), ret 8) and 1.

Writes the club's current, best and worst possible position into La Primera statistics; places 17 and 18 become 16 for the best and 19 for the worst. \n `SpaFirst::set_club_progress(club, stage, current, best, worst)`, virtual +0x68 (from `update_positions_and_status` for each table row): in the club's entry in the statistics (Comp_Stats::find_club_entry `exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`: thiscall(+8, club), ret 4) it writes the current position (`set_current_position`), the best possible (`set_best_position`; 17 and 18 become 16) and the worst (`set_worst_position`; 17 and 18 become 19): the 17 to 18 band of the Primera does not count as a band of its own [inference: positions 17 to 18 join the neighbouring band above for the best and the one below for the worst].

`SQUAD_MANAGER::process_euro_registration`: stage `step` (byte) of the European cup registration. At the first stage everyone's registration is cleared; at each stage each club in the Champions League, the UEFA Cup or the third cup [inference: the Cup Winners' Cup] picks its registered players; human-managed clubs get the news and pick themselves. In the career, stage 3 runs in 2002 (not in 2001). \n At stage 1, the registration year (+0, word) becomes the game year ([`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`]) and the registration mark (`staff::SQUAD_SELECTED_FOR`) of every person with a contract (0x6e-byte records, `staff_at`, up to [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]) is zeroed. \n Then, in each of the three cups (`EUROPEAN_REGISTRATION_CUPS`; the competition through table [`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`]), each club of the list (method +0x58 with the stage, `for_each_comp_club`) that is in it (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = the id): with a human manager (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`, ecx = [`G_NEWS`]) gets the registration news (`exe::squad_manager_send_euro_registration_news`(this, club, id, step), original); otherwise the registration is done (`exe::squad_manager_select_euro_registered_players`(club, step, 0), with ecx = [`G_SQUAD_MANAGER`]).

`SQUAD_MANAGER::get_squad_number` (this is not read): the squad number (char, negative at clubs without a human manager) of person `p` at club `c`. The number lives in the contract (`contract::SQUAD_NUMBER`); the club's contract counts (or the parent club's [inference: B team]) and, failing it, the loan contract. \n Missing either, 0. A person outside the table of contracted people (id ≥ [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]): byte +4 of the player sheet (`player()`). Otherwise the contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, thiscall on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], push person), if the person is a player (`exe::database_is_player_job` with `job_for_club()`, cdecl of 1) and the contract is valid at the club (`contract_valid_for_club`): the contract's `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER`; otherwise the loan contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`, thiscall on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], push person), if valid at the club: its `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER`; otherwise 0.

`SQUAD_MANAGER::club_uses_squad_numbers` (this is not read): 1 if the club uses fixed squad numbers. \n The competition of the club's division (the id in [`division()`], the object in table [`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`]) exists and has bit 2 of +0x52 (read as `short_gender_name()`) and, with `other` (Comp*, e.g. a cup), the other competition (the one in the table by id [other]) also has the bit. No division or no competition, 0; no club, the error box at line 0x4b0 and 0.

`SQUAD_MANAGER::set_squad_number` (this is not read): writes the squad number `n` (char from −50 to 50; outside that, the error box at line 0x332). \n Written to `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER` of person `p`'s contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) if it is valid at club `c` (`contract_valid_for_club`), otherwise to that of the loan contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) if it is valid at the club. No person or no club, nothing.

`SQUAD_MANAGER::allocate_squad_number`: gives a squad number to person `p` arriving at club `c`: the first free number for his position; goalkeeper 1; defender 2 (right back), 3 (left) or 4 to 6; defensive, central and attacking midfielder 6 to 8; striker 8 to 11 (good position = rating 15 or more). \n Marks the numbers taken by the squad (`exe::database_collect_club_squad`(c, list, 0), cdecl of 3; the list sorted by age with qsort `exe::crt_qsort` and 0x540130; anyone outside the table of contracted people (`is_contracted_staff`) or without a player sheet does not count) with each one's number (`exe::squad_manager_get_squad_number`, absolute value). If `p` is in the table and has no number yet: the first free number among the position's preferred ones (`preferred_squad_numbers`); otherwise the first free one from 12 to 50; and, if still without a number, the highest free one from 11 down. The number goes positive for a club with a human manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`(c, 0, 1, 0, 0), cdecl of 5) and negative for the others (`exe::squad_manager_set_squad_number`). No person, nothing.

`SQUAD_MANAGER::assign_league_squad_numbers`: numbers the clubs of league `league` (except B teams); a human-managed club is not numbered by the game. \n The list comes from the competition's method +0x58, thiscall(league, &list, 0), returning the count in ax; the list is freed at the end by `exe::crt_free`. In 1998 (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`) `initial` always applies. Skips the B team (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team`(club, &parent, 1) with the club linked and parent = 0). A club with a human manager (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`, with ecx = [`G_NEWS`]) without `automatico`: the squad's negative numbers (`exe::database_collect_club_squad`(club, list, 0)) become positive (`exe::squad_manager_set_squad_number`) and the manager gets the squad numbers request (`exe::squad_manager_send_squad_numbers_request_news`, original). Otherwise: with `initial`, each player of the squad (from the table of contracted people, id below [`G_STAFF_COUNT`], and with a player sheet, `staff::PLAYER`) first gets the database number (+4 of the player sheet, between 0 and 50); and the squad is numbered (`exe::squad_manager_assign_club_squad_numbers`(club, 1)).

`SQUAD_MANAGER::select_euro_registered_players` (this is not read): the registration of club `c` for the European cups at stage `step` (1 is the first; `mark` [inference: list A or B]), through the person's registration mark (`staff::SQUAD_SELECTED_FOR`: 1 or 2 registered, 4 and 8 other marks). \n From the squad (`exe::database_collect_club_squad`(c, list, 0)), the candidates are those in the table of contracted people (id below [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]), without a type-5 contract (`contract_type()` & 0x3f; the contract found (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_GET_CONTRACT`) stays in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]), without a loan contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) and without marks 8 and 0x10 (`SQUAD_SELECTED_FOR` & 0x18); outside stage 1, mark 1 drops to 0 and 4 becomes 2, and the 2s are counted. The reference line-up (`FN_MATCH_MAN_ASSIGN_PLAYERS_TO_POSITIONS` with `EURO_REFERENCE_LINEUP_SLOTS`, the 11 starters and 14 substitutes, or 9 at stage 1 without `mark`) picks the best. At stage 3, up to 2 registered players (2) left out of the line-up lose the registration (they go to 4 with `mark`, otherwise 0) and the count drops (to a minimum of 21). Then each selected player: at stage 1, is registered (1 with `mark`, otherwise 2) and counted; at the others, anyone not yet 2 and without mark 8 is registered the same way while the count is below the line-up's places. Returns the count of registered players (char).

rule: the South American qualifier is a single home and away league, 3/1 points, tiebreak 1, 2 and 3; the direct places (`set_promoted_count`) are four minus the exempt nations (the world champion and South American hosts, counted in `wc_south_american_league_fields::EXEMPT_COUNT` and `wc_south_american_league_fields::OCEANIA_EXEMPT_COUNT` [inference]); the fifth goes to the play-off (+0xbf = 1); category 10, 7 substitutes and 3 changes; starts on 25 of month 0 on weekday 5
the first record with +0 zero in table [`G_COMMON_NAME_TABLE`] (60 bytes, [`G_COMMON_NAME_COUNT`] records), cached at `G_EMPTY_COMMON_NAME_INDEX`; with none, a random one (`random`)

`database_player_initialisation(data)`: prepares every person of the new game. Called once at creation (create_game `exe::create_game`), with the "Player Initialisation" bar (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`, `exe::screenmanager_send_network_status_message` at every 1% of the people). 
 For each person: common name (`staff::COMMON_NAME` = −2: the row stored in [`G_EMPTY_COMMON_NAME_INDEX`], the first empty one or a random one), first and second name (−2: `exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`), the dates (`staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB` joined club, +0x46, +0x31), the 8 person attributes (+0x56..`staff::TEMPERAMENT`, outside 1..20: drawn at random), the adjustment by the nation's region (`nation::ACTUAL_REGION`), the missing nation (national team, club or drawn). 
 For the player (`staff::PLAYER`): the abilities (`player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, `player_sheet::HOME_REPUTATION`, `player_sheet::WORLD_REPUTATION`, in that order, each from the one that already exists), the potential (`player_sheet::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`: −2/−1/0 rarely, by draws of 2000/750/100) and the current one (`player_sheet::CURRENT_ABILITY`), the age (birth drawn when outside 14..50), the positions and sides in the vector (`exe::database_player_to_attribute_vector`), and the attributes outside 1..20 from a template: the most similar player among 250 drawn at random (global vectors `G_PLAYER_INIT_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_A`/`G_PLAYER_INIT_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_B`, flag 0x9b59b8) or, without a template, by ability. 
 For the non-player (`staff::NON_PLAYER`): the reputations (×50, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION`/`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`/`non_player::HOME_REPUTATION`), `non_player::CURRENT_ABILITY`/`non_player::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`, `non_player::DIRECTNESS`, the template among 250 (`G_NON_PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR`/0xae2238, 0x9b59b9), the job (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB` 8/9/10), the famous names (`exe::staff_name_equals`: `non_player::FORMATION`) and the missing job. At the end of each person, the age (`staff::AGE`). 
 Then the second pass: the ability-relative vectors (×10 − ability, ±200, /2) and the normalisations (`exe::staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_player_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_non_player_attributes`). 
 The stack vectors (0x54, 0x290) are only cleared on entry: what one person leaves carries over to the next, as in the original; the best score ([esp+0x40], −31073 on entry) too. No people: the error box and the end, through the original. The local at [esp+0x114] (1, zeroed with a club of reputation 0) is never read.

`database_get_job_name(job, short, upper, gender)`: the translated name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) of the job (signed byte, 0..0x11 except 14) in the text [`G_JOB_NAME_BUFFER`], which is what it returns; short or full and lower or upper case by the two ints. \n With `gender` not null and the language (`exe::langlib_get_language`) 4, writes the gender: 4 for chief executive, manager, assistant, reserve team manager and scout; 1 for the others; nothing for the retired. Job out of range: 0, without writing. \n Used in the club, contract, person and search screens, in the media (0x744f80, 0x74bbd0), in the regens (0x7a9650, 0x7aa4c0) and in transfers (0x8d3520, 0x8dc370).

`database_get_language_name(language)`: the translated name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) of the language (signed byte, 1..64; otherwise "Unknown") in the text [0xae21d4] (100 bytes), which is what it returns. \n Used in the search (0x813210) and in the person screen (0x87dd80).

`club_get_national_team_name(club, variant, text, size, style, quotes)`: the national team club name in `text` by style (`form`, byte, 1..4; otherwise does not write). \n The name is the one at `club::SHORT_NAME` with gender `short_gender_name()` (signed byte); in style 3, the one at +4 with gender `gender_name()`. Outside the national teams (id < [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`]): variant 0 copies the name (style 4: "Main Squad"); otherwise "Reserves" (styles 1 and 3), "Reserve" (2), "Reserve Squad" (4). National team with variant: "B" or "'B'" (with `aspas`), in style 4 "B Squad"/"'B' Squad". Main national team (id < clubs − nations): copies the name (style 4: "Squad"). The youth ones: under-21 or under-23 by the byte [[`G_NATIONAL_TEAMS`] + `national_teams_fields::OLYMPIC_NATION_MARKS`] + the nation's id (`nation()`), "U21"/"U23" (1), "Under 21"/"Under 23" (2), "Under 21's"/"Under 23's" (3), "Under 21 Squad"/"Under 23 Squad" (4). The formats go to `FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF` with (gender, gender, name). Returns 1. \n Size < 0x47 or null club (with style 1..4): the original (error box). Used in the club, national team and manager screens, in the match line-up (`match_screens_open_team_selection`, in Rust), in the hall of fame, in the printouts and in Setup.

`database_get_player_attribute_name(attribute, text, size, abbreviated)`: clears the text and writes the translated name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) of the player attribute (1..0x1f, signed byte), abbreviated (`abbreviated` not null) or full; returns 1. \n The map splits the routine at 0x542f48, which is just its middle: the real boundary goes up to `staff_get_player_attribute`. Attribute out of range, null text or size (signed short) < 100: the original (error box and 0). Used in the club, search, person and training screens.

`database_format_player_positions(player, text, size, style)`: the text of the player's positions (ratings +0xf..+0x1a, signed bytes) by style (`form`, byte): 1 abbreviated ("D/DM RC"), 2 full with the sides in parentheses, 3 full without the sides, 4 and others the letters. 
 The line (`append_position_text`): with the minimum rating going from 15 down to 10 (stopping when something is found): goalkeeper (`goalkeeper()`), sweeper (`sweeper()`), defender (`defender()`), defensive midfielder (`defensive_midfielder()`) or attacking midfielder (`attacking_midfielder()` and `midfielder()`) or midfielder (`midfielder()`), and striker (`attacker()`; "forward" if also `attacking_midfielder()`, `right_side()`, `left_side()` or `free_role()`). Goalkeeper at the rating: only the line. Nothing down to 10: attacking midfielder, and with `attacking_midfielder()` ≥ 15 the original WRITES 15 into the player's `midfielder()` (`set_midfielder`; so does the copy). 
 The sides (rating ≥ 15): right (+0x17), left (+0x18), centre (+0x19); style 1 abbreviated together, 2 full with a slash, 4 the letters A, B, C only with empty sides. End: style 2 "%s (%s)", the others "%s %s" or just the line. Returns 1. 
 The translated texts (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) go through the global [0xde1f64] (the same use as the original). Null text or player or size (signed short) < 30: the original (error box). The locals (line and sides, 2 KB each) are written before being read. Used in the club, search, person, tactics and training screens and in the printouts.

`database_format_name_from_ids(first, surname, common, text, size, style, person)`: looks up the name records (60 bytes) by index in tables [`G_FIRST_NAME_TABLE`], [`G_SECOND_NAME_TABLE`] and [`G_COMMON_NAME_TABLE`] (−1 or less: null) and builds the text through `exe::database_format_name_from_strings` (with −1 at the end), which is what it returns. \n With `person` > −1 and [`G_HUMAN_MANAGER`]: if a human gave the person a nickname ([`G_STAFF_TABLE`] + `staff::SIZE` × person; `exe::human_manager_has_nickname`) and it matches the names (`exe::database_staff_matches_names`), the nickname (`exe::human_manager_get_nickname`) replaces the common name. \n Null text or size (word) < 0x69: the original (error box). The 0x200-byte locals serve only the box message. Called through the game's address. ~126 callers (news, screens, contracts).

`database_format_official_name(official, text, size, style)`: the official's name (first name +4, surname +8) in `text` by style (`form`, byte): 1 "%s %s", 2 "%c.%s", 3 "%s, %s" (surname first), 4 "%s, %c", 5 the surname only, 6 "%c %c" (the initials). \n With one of the two missing: the surname (or the first name); in style 6, whichever initial exists. Official of nation `official::NATION` with id equal to [`KEY_NATION_SPAIN`]: surname only, in any style. Returns 1. \n Null official or text, size (word) < 0x69 or style outside 1..6: the original (error box). Used in the events and the match panel (`event_text`, `commentate_on_panel`, `draw_match_overview_panel`).

`position_mask_get_text(mask, text, upper)`: the translated position name of the mask (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF` with text 0xad9c64; the capitalised form if byte `capital` is not 0), and the gender by language. \n In order: goalkeeper (1), support player (0x260/0x160/0x460), striker (0x40 with 0x700), wing back (0x88/0x808), left winger (0x90/0xa0), right winger (0x810/0x820), central midfielder and attacking midfielder (0x100/0x200/0x400 with 0x18 or 0x20), centre back (0x204/0x104/0x404), left back (0x84), right back (0x804), sweeper (2), substitute (0) and defender. \n Returns the gender byte by language (`exe::langlib_get_language`): 2 gives 2 or 5, 5 gives 1, 4 gives 1 or 4, the others 0 (substitute: always 0). Null text: 0. Used in the media (0x72d270) and in the person screen (0x87dd80).

`write_position_name(mask, text, size)`: the translated position name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`; each one writes over the previous; the last one written wins), counting the positions. \n 1 goalkeeper, 2 sweeper, 4 centre back (with 0x200 without 0x80/0x800), defender (with 0x200) or full back, 8 wing back (without 4 and 0x200) or defensive midfielder (with 0x200), 0x10 midfielder, 0x20 with none before (counts 1) attacking midfielder (0x200), winger (0x80 and 0x800), left winger (0x80) or right winger, 0x40 with 0x200 striker; more than 3: "utility player"; none: "player". \n Returns the gender byte of the last one by language (`exe::langlib_get_language`): 2 gives 2 or 5, 5 gives 1, 4 gives 1 or 4; the others do not change it (starts at 0). Size < 30: the original (error box). Used in the media, contracts, player search, scouts and transfers (0x8dc370).

`write_player_description(person, position, strengths, text, size, gender)`: the player description (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) by strengths (`qualidades`, those of `staff_get_player_strength_flags`) and by the position mask. 
 Forward (strengths 0x40): lethal finisher, finisher or pacy goalscorer (by the sum index + strengths % 3), poacher, finisher or goalscorer (% 4), dynamic, powerful, strong, creative, exciting or skilful striker. Midfielder (position 0x10): with 0x40000 "inspirational" and on top "free-scoring" (returns 0); playmaker, ball winner, dynamic, hard-working, reliable, pacy. Strengths 2 (without 4): pacy or exciting full back; 4: pacy or technical defender. 
 Otherwise, by age (`age()` of the person [`G_STAFF_TABLE`] + `staff::SIZE` × index): veteran above index % 3 + 33 (without strength 1), rookie below index % 3 + 18 with `int_apps()` null and the sum % 3 = 0. 
 Returns the gender: with language 4, 1, 3 or 4 depending on the text; otherwise the byte `gender` (1 with language 5, which the original also writes into the argument itself; the copy does not write). Size < 30: the original (error box).

The original stores the candidate's score in the argument `person` itself and a float in `candidate` (written before being read); the copy does not. Only `al`. Used in the media (`process_transfer_squad_reactions`).

`database_compare_staff_by_full_name(a, b)`: qsort comparison of person pointers by the style-1 name ("first name surname", `exe::database_format_staff_name` into 0x7d0 bytes) through the text comparison `exe::utils_string_compare` (case-insensitive, `compare_text_nocase`); a null person counts as the empty text. \n Used in the menu (0x7612c0) and the transfer manager (0x8e55f0).

club scoring fewer than 1.5 goals a game (`rdata::F64_1_5`): 0; otherwise 1 when more than 1 striker (`player_sheet::ATTACKER` = 20) without serious injury is above the limit (reputation/65 + 40, 40 to 150, `squad_ability_threshold`)

Only by the scout.

`club_squad_strength_band(club, other)`: the squad strength band, 0..6. Null club: 3. \n Gathers those in the squad (`club::SQUAD`) with a player record (`staff::PLAYER`) and id < [`G_STAFF_COUNT`] (read once) into a local array of 50, sorts it with the CRT qsort (`exe::crt_qsort`) using the comparison `compare_staff_by_player_ability_desc` (through the game's address) and sums the current ability (the player's +5) of the first min(n − 1, 16). With nothing summed: by reputation (`reputation()`; > 7250: 6, > 5750: 5, > 4750: 4, > 3250: 3, > 2250: 2, otherwise 1); otherwise by the average (> 155: 6, > 135: 5, > 110: 4, > 85: 3, > 60: 2, > 40: 1, otherwise 0). \n With `other` (the scout's club): its reputation > 7250 takes off 2 if the club's is < 4250 and the band > 2, and 1 more if the club's is < 7250 and the band > 0; otherwise, its reputation < 4250 adds 1 if the band < 5. In the same competition (`division()` equal), a reputation gap (16 bits) > 1250 takes off 1 (band > 0, byte +4 of the table [`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE`] of 6 bytes per id: the other's ≥ 0 and the club's ≤ 0); < 1250 adds 1 (band < 5, the club's ≥ 0 and the other's ≤ 0). At the end, between 0 and 6. Only `al`. Only by the scout.

`club_reputation_for_staff(club, person)`: the club's reputation (`reputation()`) as seen by the person. \n No division (`division()`): the reputation. With the division's league ([`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`][id]) and the division's reputation (the division's `reputation()`) × 500 above the club's: the position (`current_position()` of `exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` on the league's table `comp_stats()`; no row: 0) scaled to 20 clubs (`club_count()`) gives the weight from table 0x9b59c0; with fewer than 20 games (+4 of the row) it is mixed with the weight of the previous position (`last_position()`, if `last_division()` = `division()`; otherwise 1.3, `rdata::F64_1_3`) × 0.05 (`rdata::F64_0_05`); if the person plays (`player()`) and the contract is with the club (`database_club_of_contract`), adds the average `exe::playerstats_get_stat`(data, 6, 20, weight) and divides by 2, and gets ±500 from the preferences (favoured or disliked club, `club_preference_bonus`); the weight becomes x = 14p − 18 between 0 and 10 and the result is ((10 − x) × reputation + x × division × 500 (16 bits)) / 10 truncated, plus the ±500. Otherwise: the reputation ±500 (a person who plays, with a contract at the club). \n Callers read only `ax`; the rest of eax follows the original (the register left over on each path). Writes [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`] (the contract found). Used in the daily person update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0, two calls).
