Returns the club (the original's eax). Used in the dispute hearings (DISPUTE::process_hearings 0x569ed0).

`staff_remove_favoured_staff(person, target)`: removes the target from the person's three favoured people (preferences `preferences::STAFF_FAVOURITE_STAFF1`/+0x20/+0x24, the first one that matches, `remove_from_list3`). \n Null person, preferences or target: nothing. Returns the original's eax (the preferences; null person: 0). Used in disputes (0x569ed0), squad relationships (game_update_squad_relationships `game_update_squad_relationships`, daily), the return from injury (`post_recovery_news`), MANAGER_MANAGER (0x697a7a) and the media (0x75a340).

`staff_remove_disliked_staff(person, target)`: clears the first of the person's three disliked people (preferences `preferences::STAFF_DISLIKED_STAFF1`/+0x2c/+0x30) that is the target. \n Null person, preferences or target: nothing. Returns the original's eax (the preferences; null person: 0). Used in squad relationships (game_update_squad_relationships `game_update_squad_relationships`, daily), the return from injury (`post_recovery_news`) and the media (0x7414ac, 0x75a340).

`club_is_in_season(club)`: null club, 0; otherwise what `exe::key_nation_club_in_season`(club, null, null) returns (1 = today is inside the season of the club's nation), the whole eax (the default contract `exe::staff_contract_default_staff_contract` tests eax). \n At creation: the people's default contract (CONTRACT_MANAGER::initialise_all_staff_contracts → 0x85e960 → `exe::staff_contract_default_staff_contract`) and the default wage of the initial lists (0x83a1b0 → `exe::staff_contract_calc_unset_default_wage`).

`club_is_in_major_nation(club)`: 1 if the club's nation (`nation()`) has the id (+0) of one of the index.cpp keys England `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND`, France `KEY_NATION_FRANCE`, Germany `KEY_NATION_GERMANY`, Italy `KEY_NATION_ITALY`, Spain `KEY_NATION_SPAIN` or Holland `KEY_NATION_HOLLAND`; null club or nation: 0. \n Only `al` (the rest of eax is the nation's id). At creation, through the default contract (`exe::staff_contract_default_staff_contract`) and the default wage (`exe::staff_contract_calc_unset_default_wage`).

`staff_clear_opinion_links(person)`: −1 in both links (id and value) of the person's contract (`staff_state::OPINION_LINK_STAFF_ID`, `staff_state::OPINION_LINK_FLAG`, and the same + 0x14); null person or id ≥ [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]: nothing (`database_staff_state_record`). \n At creation, for each generated contract (0x85e960, through CONTRACT_MANAGER::initialise_all_staff_contracts); in the career, in offers and complaints.

`staff_add_opinion_link(person, other, value)`: with both people valid (not null, id < [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]), writes the id of `other` and the `value` into the first link if it is empty (+0x27 = −1), otherwise into the second (+0x3b/+0x4b, overwriting whatever is there). \n In the career, through the contract events (`exe::staff_contract_apply_event_flags`).

`database_get_club_assistant(club)`: the club's assistant (`assistant_manager()`); without one, that of the partner A/B team (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with null and 1, which zeroes the club's flag +0x244 when it rejects the partner); none: 0. \n Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the coach distribution (`update_coach_assignments`, in hirings and transfers), the regeneration (`process_regen_queue`) and the screens.

`database_get_club_coaches(club, array)`: the club's 5 coaches (`club::COACHES`) into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (`FN_CLUB_GET_LINKED_B_TEAM` with null and 1): the 5 slots as they are. With a partner: the club's non-null ones and then the partner's, up to 5; the rest zeroed only when the two together do not fill the 5. 8-bit counter in the original (at most 5). Returns 1. Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the coach distribution (`update_coach_assignments`).

`database_count_club_coaches(club)`: how many of the club's 5 coaches (`coaches()`) are valid people (not null, id (+0) < [`G_STAFF_COUNT`], signed) plus those of the partner A/B team (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with null and 1, always called). \n Only `al` (the rest of eax is the partner's). Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the regeneration queue (PLAYER_REGEN::process_regen_queue `process_regen_queue`).

`nation_get_english_three_letter_name(nation)`: the nation's three-letter code, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([`G_DATABASE_NAMES_LANGUAGE`]) 0 or 1: its own code (+0x53). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([`G_ENGLISH_NAME_TABLES`]): nations in 109-byte rows from `english_name_tables::NATION_ROWS`, by id (without checking the count), the code at +0x4f of the row. SEH frame only on first use.

`stadium_get_english_name(stadium)`: the stadium's name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([`G_DATABASE_NAMES_LANGUAGE`]) 0 or 1: its own name (+4). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([`G_ENGLISH_NAME_TABLES`]), 52-byte rows at [t + `english_name_tables::STADIUM_ROWS`], by id. SEH frame only on first use (new 0x40 and the load 0x544fc0), which stays with the original.

`database_generate_extra_non_playing_staff()`: fills coaches, scouts and physios of the clubs of chosen nations by reputation and creates unattached managers for clubs without one. Called once at creation (by 0x524d70 at the start of the trims). 
 Checks the people with job 8 (`any_coach_missing_from_club`; box 0x62f on the first one outside the club's slots, and carries on). Then, in each club that is not a national team (id < [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`]), is not a weak club of key `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND` (`is_weak_english_club`), has a chosen nation (`nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED`) and is not the A team of a pair (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 1): tops up coaches (+0x19f, 5, job 8), scouts (+0x1b3, 7, job 9) and physios (+0x1cf, 3, job 10) up to (reputation + 500) × slots / 10000, between 1 and the number of slots, with people from the reserve rows (`make_extra_staff`, nation `staff::NATION`, `staff::CLASSIFICATION` = 1, random birth date `set_extra_staff_birth_date`, names of the nation) placed in the first free slot. 
 Finally, each club without a manager (`club::MANAGER`) that is a national team or (with nation, division `club::DIVISION`, chosen nation and reputation ≠ 0) or with reputation > 7500, except the weak ones of `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND`, gets a manager (job 5 in `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`, `staff::JOB_FOR_NATION` = 5) with no club and no national team (he does not go into the slot). 
 Over 23,000: box (0x65f, 0x6aa, 0x6f5, 0x734) and 0. Writes "generated %ld extra non playing staff" to 0xde1f64 and returns 1. The pair local is only read when `exe::club_get_linked_b_team` returns a partner.

`database_trim_club_table(size)`: trims the club table by the database size. Called once at creation (create_game). Small = size 1 or 2. 
 Per nation (calloc `exe::crt_calloc` of 0xd0 bytes per nation: 50 ids, count `nation_club_bucket::CLUB_COUNT`, index of the lowest `nation_club_bucket::WEAKEST_SLOT`), the clubs with the highest reputation (`reputation()`, signed 16 bits): up to 20 (15 in the small one); a nation not chosen (`nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED`) and outside the 15 nation keys: up to 5 (size 2) or 11 (size 1). Also kept: the clubs of people (+0x39, +0x24), those of the competition histories (+0xa, +0xe, +0x12, in range) and, outside the small one, those of the history of people with a chosen nation; the national teams; the club keys (`exe::remap_club_key_id` receives each id with the new row and returns 1 if it is a key); and those of chosen nations, except (in the small one) the weak ones of `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND`. 
 Swaps the club pointers (club +0xb3/+0xb7/+0xbb, person +0x39/+0x24, preferences +4..+0x18, people history +0xa, competition history +0xa..+0x16) for the new ones (null for those removed), builds [`G_CLUB_ENGLISH_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`] (new row → old id, malloc), compacts the table (id = new row), reallocs in place (another address: box 0x4ca and the end) and writes "Club table has %d entries" to 0xde1f64. 
 Without [`G_NATION_TABLE`] (box) or out of memory on new: the original; out of memory on the callocs: box and the end, as the original.

`database_prune_comp_history_table()`: called once at creation. Compacts the club competition history ([`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_TABLE`], [`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_COUNT`] rows of 26 bytes): a row stays if it has a competition (+4) whose nation (`nation()`) is null or chosen (`league_selected()`), copied forward within the table itself. \n realloc (`exe::crt_realloc`) to the new size, which becomes [`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_TABLE`] (without checking the address); [`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_COUNT`] = rows; [`G_NATION_COMP_HISTORY_TABLE`] (the national teams part) = table + (rows − [`G_NATION_COMP_HISTORY_COUNT`]) × 26; qsort (`exe::crt_qsort`) with `database_compare_comp_history_rows`.

`resolve_database_indexes(lenient)`: replaces every id field of the 12 tables with the record pointer (table + id × bytes). Called at load (load_database, with 0) and at save (save_database, after writing). \n In the original's order and with its rules: negative → null; some with a "greater than the count" ceiling (an id equal to the count passes), others "from the count on", others with no ceiling. Club: nation, divisions, stadiums, colours, people and clubs (+0x53..+0xbb, inclusive ceiling; a log line in 0xde1f64 for high nation, last division and stadium); squad `club::SQUAD` (50; with `leniente` = 0, from [`G_STAFF_COUNT`] on it becomes null, with a log line above [`G_STAFF_COUNT`] + 0x52d), scouts, coaches, physios, directors, manager, chairman, assistant and the 20 selected (+0x1e0), with log lines. Then nations, referees, stadiums, preferences, non-players, people (player, preferences and non-player out of range: log line, box and null), person competitions, people history, cities, competition history and club competitions. \n Defects of the original, copied: the club's high last division (`club::LAST_DIVISION`) zeroes `club::RESERVE_DIVISION` (which later becomes competition 0) and stays raw; the high neighbouring stadium (`stadium::NEARBY_STADIUM`) zeroes the city (`stadium::CITY`) and stays raw. Does not read the target records nor allocate.

`database_sort_clubs_by_reputation(rebuild)`: called at creation, in load_game_data `load_game_data` (vector missing from the save) and in the daily loop 0x5cccd0. \n With `redo` (byte) ≠ 0, the vector [`G_CLUB_REPUTATION_ORDER`] receives the ids (+0) of the [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] clubs in table order; then qsort (`exe::crt_qsort`) of the [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] ids with 0x540020 (by reputation).

`database_free_staff_history_table()`: with the people history table ([`G_STAFF_HISTORY_TABLE`], 17 bytes) present, frees it (`free_database_table`: 0x9670f4, GlobalFree in the shared database, or `exe::crt_free`, free, by the database mode) and zeroes the pointer and the count [`G_STAFF_HISTORY_COUNT`]. \n TapeCall through PlayerStats::PlayerStats (0x7c0ccd): the history moves to `player stats history.tmp`. No stack frame.

`database_grow_comp_history_table(n)`: `realloc` `exe::crt_realloc` of the competition history ([`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_TABLE`], 26 bytes) to [`G_CLUB_COMP_HISTORY_COUNT`] + `n` rows; out of memory returns 0 and nothing changes. \n Otherwise adds `n` to the count, stores the block, rebuilds the pointer to the national teams part [`G_NATION_COMP_HISTORY_TABLE`] (from row [`G_NATION_COMP_HISTORY_COUNT`]) and clears the `n` new rows (+0 = the row's index, the rest zero); returns 1. TapeCall through comp_util_add_history_record (0x4afd2c), at the end of a competition. No stack frame.

qsort comparison of the club id vector (`database_sort_clubs_by_reputation`) by reputation, highest first. \n By the reputation (+0x80, signed word) of the club ([`G_CLUB_TABLE`] + id × 581; id −1 or lower = reputation 0): `a`'s lower than `b`'s: 1; higher: −1; equal: 0.

qsort comparison of squads (the trim of the joint A+B squad at `database_trim_senior_and_b_team_squads` and the MLS all-star selections at `exe::usamlsallstars_select_squads`): person pointers. \n A null person goes last (a null and b not: 1; a not and b null: −1; both: 0); then by the player's word `current_reputation()` (person `player()`; no player, 0), highest first (b − a).

qsort comparison of the squad in the team strength (club_squad_strength_band `club_squad_strength_band`): person pointers. \n No person or no player record (`player()`) in `a`: 1 (even if `b` is the same); in `b`: −1; then by current ability (`current_ability()`, signed word) and, when tied, by the word `current_reputation()`, highest first (b − a).

`staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes(person)`: lowers the physical attributes above the current ability and rebalances the attribute vector. \n With the player record (person `player()`): removes the training progress (`remove_or_restore_training`); cut = (ability `current_ability()` / 2 − ftol(weighted sum of the physical attributes × [0x969528]) + 0x37) / 2, the sum with the .rdata constants (`player_sheet::PLAYER_PACE`, `player_sheet::LEADERSHIP`, `player_sheet::JUMPING`, `player_sheet::ACCELERATION`, `player_sheet::TEAMWORK`, `player_sheet::TECHNIQUE`, the lower of `player_sheet::RIGHT_FOOT`/`player_sheet::LEFT_FOOT`, plus `player_sheet::WORK_RATE`); cut < −14: adds max(cut / 15, −2) to +0x1b, +0x36, +0x40 and +0x44 (at least 1); target = cut − 20 − min((`PLAYER_PACE` × `ACCELERATION`) / 2 − ability, 25) when it exceeds the ability, clamped to −40..0; vector (0xff81/0x81) through `player_attr_vector`, `rebalance_attr_vector` without cells 0x18 and 0x1e (0x11/0x12 count double), back through `exe::database_attribute_vector_to_player`; player `goalkeeper()` = 20: removes the averages of +0x2a/+0x3a (`subtract_mean_2a_3a`) and the third of `player_sheet::ANTICIPATION`, `player_sheet::DECISIONS`, `player_sheet::POSITIONING` (pair and trio averages); restores the training progress.

A second name (60-byte row in [`G_SECOND_NAME_TABLE`]) by weight. \n A nation with more than 10 second names (`nation_name_index` `nation_name_index::SECOND_NAME_COUNT`): 3 draws in its range (from `nation_name_index::SECOND_NAME_START`), the one with the highest weight is kept (`names::WEIGHT`, signed; starts at −1, and row 0 if none passes). No nation or up to 10: a draw over the whole table ([0xae239c], at most 0x7fff). Only the CRT rand() (`scaled_crt_rand`). TapeCall through OfficialsManager::add_random_officials (0x79c6b4), when creating the referees of a new game.

`staff_normalise_player_attributes(person)`: rebalances the player's attribute vector with target −20. \n With the player record (person `player()`): removes the training progress (`remove_or_restore_training`), builds the vector through `player_attr_vector` (without pre-filling: the cells used all come from it), `rebalance_attr_vector` with target −20 in all cells of the range (12 cells within the limit, excess above 85 spread; 0x11/0x12 count ftol(value × `rdata::F64_1_75`)), back through `exe::database_attribute_vector_to_player`; player `goalkeeper()` ≥ 15: removes the averages of +0x2a/+0x3a (`subtract_mean_2a_3a`); restores the training progress. \n Runs at creation (after `staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`), at load and in training.

`club_get_english_short_name(club)`: the club's short name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([`G_DATABASE_NAMES_LANGUAGE`]) 0 or 1: its own short name (+0x38). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([`G_ENGLISH_NAME_TABLES`], 79-byte rows from `english_name_tables::CLUB_ROWS`, the short name at +0x34 of the row): through the id map [`G_CLUB_ENGLISH_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`] if present, otherwise by id if < the count (+0), otherwise 0.

`database_trim_senior_and_b_team_squads()`: flags every club that has a partner team and trims each joint senior+B squad to 48. Called once at creation (create_game 0x8282f1). \n In each club, the flag `club::HAS_LINKED_CLUB` = has a partner (`FN_CLUB_GET_LINKED_B_TEAM` with 0) and the partner has a nation (`nation()`). In the A team (`is_a`): the joint A+B squad (`exe::database_collect_club_squad` with double: 100 pointers) in reputation order (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x5402f0); from the back to the front, while the joint squad has more than 48, removes the person from her club (`exe::database_remove_staff_from_club` with the club `staff::CLUB_JOB`, no date, detaching the person, not as a player), skipping the goalkeepers (player `player()` with `goalkeeper()` ≥ 15, signed byte) while 3 or fewer remain. \n Signed 8-bit counters, like the original's. No draw; the local `is_a` is only read when `FN_CLUB_GET_LINKED_B_TEAM` returns a partner (and then it was written).

`database_merge_b_team_staff()`: for every senior team with a B team, trims the B squad and moves the B backroom staff to the senior club. Called once at creation (create_game 0x8283d9). \n For each A team with a B partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 1, which requires the `club::HAS_LINKED_CLUB` flag from `database_trim_senior_and_b_team_squads`): counts the valid people (non-null pointer and id < [`G_STAFF_COUNT`]) of the A squad (+0xd7, 50), sorts the B squad (`club::SQUAD`, qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x540130) and removes from B those beyond 50 in the joint total. \n Then, in slots +0x19f (5, job 8), +0x1b3 (7, job 9) and +0x1cf (3, job 10): each valid person of B leaves it (`exe::database_remove_staff_from_club`) and, while A has room, joins A (`exe::database_add_staff_to_club` with the game date `G_CURRENT_DATE`, writing into the person). Manager (`club::MANAGER`, `manager()`): with both, B's just leaves; only B's: leaves and joins A with his job (`job_for_club()`, read after leaving; the original pushes the byte with garbage above it, and `exe::database_add_staff_to_club` uses only the byte), no date. Assistant (`club::ASSISTANT_MANAGER`, `assistant_manager()`): with both, B's leaves. No draw.

`database_build_nation_name_index()`: allocates and builds the per-nation index of the first, second and common name tables. Called at creation (create_game 0x82836c) and when loading the game. \n Allocates (malloc `exe::crt_malloc`) [`G_NATION_COUNT`] entries of 0x24 bytes in [`G_NATION_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`]: first row (+0, +4, +8 = −1), weight total (+0xc, +0x10, +0x14 = 0) and count (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x20 = 0) of the first, second and common names. Walks (`fill_nation_name_index`) the second names ([`G_SECOND_NAME_TABLE`], [0xae239c]), the first names ([`G_FIRST_NAME_TABLE`], [0xae2398]) and the common names ([`G_COMMON_NAME_TABLE`], [`G_COMMON_NAME_COUNT`]), 60-byte rows with the nation at `names::NATION` (0..[`G_NATION_COUNT`]) and the weight at `names::WEIGHT` (signed byte): consecutive rows of the same nation form a group, written into the entry of the nation's id (+0) when the nation changes. \n Defect of the original, copied: the last group of each table is not written. Out of memory: the original.

`database_remove_staff_from_club(club, person, date, detach, as_player)`: removes the person from the club slot her job points to; 0 if she was not in the slot. Called at creation (the trims of `database_trim_senior_and_b_team_squads`, `database_merge_b_team_staff` and 0x524d70) and in the career (transfers, sackings). 
 National team = club id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`]. With `data`: its 8 bytes go into the person (`staff::DATE_JOINED_NATION` for a national team, otherwise `staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`; `exe::date_operator_3d` copies +2, +0 and +4 and repeats into a local nobody reads), before looking at the job. Job = person `job_for_nation()` (national team) or `job_for_club()` (byte); with `how_player`, 11, 12, 13 and 15 become 11 and the others 0. 
 Slots (jump table 0x53c54c): 0 none; 1 +0xbf; 2..4 +0xc3 (3); 5 +0xcf and, for the senior national team (id < [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − [`G_NATION_COUNT`]), the under-21 side's `club::MANAGER` (`exe::database_get_national_u21_team` with the nation `club::NATION`) if it is the same person; 6, 7 +0xd3; 8 +0x19f (5); 9 +0x1b3 (7); 10 +0x1cf (3); 11 squad +0xd7 (50); 12 +0xcf and the squad; 13 +0xd3 and the squad; 15 +0x19f and the squad; 14, above 15 or negative: 0. 
 The slot that has the person (the first) is zeroed; person not in the slot: 0 (in 12, 13 and 15 the first slot, already zeroed, stays so). With `disable`: clears the club in the person (`set_national_job` for a national team, `set_club_job` for a club). Returns 1. Null club: 0. Null person: the original ("Error" box and 0).

`database_get_club_scouts(club, array)`: the 7 scouts (`club::SCOUTS`) of `club` into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with null and 1, which zeroes the club's flag +0x244 when it rejects the partner): the 7 slots as they are. With a partner: the club's non-null ones and then the partner's, up to 7; the rest zeroed only when the two together do not fill the 7. 8-bit counter in the original (at most 7). Returns 1. Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through `sync_scout_lists` (the scouts' lists, in transfers and hirings).
the person's coaching attribute 1..12: `exe::staff_compute_non_player_attribute` with their non-player record (`non_player()`)

A first name (60-byte row in [`G_FIRST_NAME_TABLE`]) by weight. \n A nation with more than 15 first names (`nation_name_index` `nation_name_index::FIRST_NAME_COUNT`): 3 draws in its range, the one with the highest weight is kept (`names::WEIGHT`, signed; starts at −1, and row 0 if none passes). No nation or up to 15: a draw over the whole table ([0xae2398], at most 0x7fff). Only the CRT rand() (`scaled_crt_rand`).

The colours of `competition` in pixels (`exe::graphics_rgb_to_pixel` with bytes `colour::RED`, `colour::GREEN`, `colour::BLUE` of the colour and format 0): `front` and `bottom`, which start with [`G_GUI_COLOUR_PALE_GREY`] and [`G_GUI_COLOUR_DARK_BLUE`]. \n The colours come from the `nation()` record (its `foreground_colour1()` and `background_colour1()`) or, without it, from the competition itself (`foreground_colour()` and `background_colour()`); a null colour leaves the default. Returns 1. Null competition: the original (defaults, "Error" box and 0).

Puts `person` at `club` in `job` (byte, jump table 0x53c14c), copies the date and writes club and job into the person. 
 A person in the humans' range (id ≥ [`G_STAFF_COUNT`] − 16) only in job 5. With `data`: its 8 bytes go into the person (`staff::DATE_JOINED_NATION` if the club is a national team, id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`]; otherwise `staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`; `exe::date_operator_3d` copies +2, +0 and +4 and repeats into a local nobody reads). With `reduzir`: jobs 11, 12, 13 and 15 become 11, the others 0. A player (`player()`) with current ability (+5) > 85 at a club without a human manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 0, 1, 0, 0): 6 becomes 13 and 8 becomes 15. 
 Slots: 1 `club::CHAIRMAN`; 2..4 +0xc3 (3); 5 `club::MANAGER`; 6, 7 `club::ASSISTANT_MANAGER`; 8 +0x19f (5); 9 +0x1b3 (7); 10 +0x1cf (3); 11 squad +0xd7 (50); 12 `club::MANAGER` and the squad (no room in the squad: 0 with `club::MANAGER` already written); 13 `club::ASSISTANT_MANAGER` and the squad (no room in the squad, stays 6); 15 +0x19f and the squad (no room in the squad, stays 8); 0 none; 14 and outside: 0. 
 With `write`: club and job into the person (`set_national_job`/`set_job_for_nation` national team, `set_club_job`/`set_job_for_club` club). Returns 1. Null club or person: the original ("Error" box and 0).

How many valid people are in the squad of `club` (byte). \n With an A/B partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 1): `mode` 2 and an A club counts only the partner; otherwise counts the club and, except for `mode` 1 with a B club, also the partner. Without a partner and with a reserve team (`exe::database_club_has_reserve_squad`): only the people with the `mode` bits in the squad flags (`staff::PLAYING_SQUAD`), if `mode` is not 0. \n With `filter`, someone who has a loan contract record (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) and a club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) other than `club` only counts if the contract's club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, stored in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]; `club()` = id) is also another one (the loanee filter). Null club: the original (error box).

Copies the squad of `club` (50 pointers at +0xd7) into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with null and 1): the 50 as they are and, with `dobro`, 50 more zeros. With a partner: only the valid people of the club and then those of the partner, up to the limit (100 with `dobro`, otherwise 50), the rest up to the limit zeroed. Returns 1. Null club: the original (error box and 0).

Whether `club` can be managed. Needs a nation (`club::NATION`). \n National teams (id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`], signed): only the senior ones (id < [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − [`G_NATION_COUNT`]) of a nation with `nation::NUMBER_STAFF` > 150. Clubs: with a competition (`club::DIVISION`), not the B team of a pair (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 1), with the competition in the vector [[`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`] + id × 4] (active) and the nation with bit 2 of `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED` (`league_selected::PLAYABLE`, flagged).

The inverse of `database_non_player_to_attribute_vector`: the low byte of each of the 21 three-byte cells of `array` goes back to `not_player` (the coaching attributes +0x0e..+0x22) in the order `NON_PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE_ORDER`. \n The person is not used. eax on exit: the vector with the last copied byte in the low byte (callers do not use it).

The inverse of `database_player_to_attribute_vector`: the low byte of cells 0..53 of `array` goes back to `player` at the offsets of `ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_CELLS`, and that of cell 54 to `person` `set_determination` (+0x58). \n eax on exit: the vector with the last byte in the low byte (callers do not use it).

Rebalances the attributes of the non-player (person `non_player()`) in two passes. \n Builds the vector (63 cells 0xff81/0x81, filled by `exe::database_non_player_to_attribute_vector`, which returns the cut 13) and, twice, starting from the cut: (1) with limit 40, +10 per round, up to 6 cells with |value| ≤ limit (marked); cell 19 outside the limit is also marked; (2) adds −5 − mean to the marked ones (clamped to −125..125), pulling the mean of the near-zero cells to −5; in the 1st pass the unmarked positive ones go into the excess sum, the others are marked; with job `job_for_club()` or `job_for_nation()` = 10 (`job_kind::PHYSIO`), the cells stay ≤ −80 and cell 19 ≥ 0; (3) in the 1st pass, with sum > 28, takes (sum − 28) / count off the unmarked ones (minimum 0). \n At the end, `exe::database_attribute_vector_to_non_player` writes back. Null person or non-player: nothing.
whether two colours clash (`exe::database_get_colour_family`): same family or the pairs 8-9, 8-7, 6-7 and family 6 against the colour keyed at [`KEY_COLOUR_PURPLE_3`]

The coaching `attribute` (1..12) of `person`, from her `not_player` record (+0x69). \n Direct: 1 person `adaptability()`, 4 person `determination()`, 7 non-player `discipline()`, 12 `youngsters()`. The others (2 `non_player::COACHING_GKS`, 3 `non_player::COACHING`, 5 `non_player::JUDGEMENT`, 6 `non_player::JUDGING_POTENTIAL`, 8 `non_player::MAN_HANDLING`, 9 `non_player::MOTIVATING`, 10 `non_player::PHYSIOTHERAPY`, 11 `non_player::TACTICS`) through the 1-to-20 formula of `exe::non_player_attribute_rating`: x = (word `current_ability()` + 2 × byte) × 0.05 + 10; (x + 0.1 x²) / 3 + 0.5, clamped to 1..20 and truncated. \n Null person or non-player, or attribute outside 1..12: the original (error box and −1).

A first name (60-byte row in [`G_FIRST_NAME_TABLE`]) for `nation`. \n No nation: a draw over the whole table. A nation with more than 100 first names (`nation_name_index::FIRST_NAME_COUNT`): 20 draws in its range, the one with the highest weight (`names::WEIGHT`, signed) among the accepted ones (`is_acceptable_name`) is kept. With up to 100: language group (`first_language()`) 0 draws over the whole table, but returns the row of the SECOND names table ([`G_SECOND_NAME_TABLE`], as in the original); otherwise borrows from `name_donor_nation` (the language group). Only the CRT rand() (`scaled_crt_rand`, not `exe::utils_random`).

Writes the name of `person` into `target` in `style` (byte, 1..7), with first name (+4), surname (+8) and common name (`staff::COMMON_NAME`, or the nickname given by the human: `exe::human_manager_has_nickname`/`exe::human_manager_get_nickname` on [`G_HUMAN_MANAGER`]). \n 1 "first surname", 2 "F.surname", 3 "surname, first", 4 "surname, F", 5 a single name, 6 initials, 7 like 1 without preferring the common name; always with fallbacks (whatever there is). Returns 1. \n Null person or destination, size (i16) < 0x69 or style outside 1..7: the original (error box and 0).

The colours of `kit` (byte: 1 home `club::FORE_COLOUR1`/`club::BACK_COLOUR1`, 2 away +0x8b/+0x8f, 3 third +0x93/+0x97; 2 and 3 with one of the two colours missing: the home ones swapped) of `club` as screen pixels (`exe::graphics_rgb_to_pixel` with bytes `colour::RED`, `colour::GREEN`, `colour::BLUE` of the colour and format 0): `front` and `bottom`, which start with [`G_GUI_COLOUR_BLUE`] and [`G_GUI_COLOUR_PALE_GREY`]. \n Any other kit: only the defaults. Returns 1. Null club: the original (defaults, "Error" box and 0).

The manager (`manager()`) of `club`; without one, that of the A/B partner (`FN_CLUB_GET_LINKED_B_TEAM` with 0 and 1); without either, an ordinary club gives 0 and a national team (id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − [`G_NATION_COUNT`]) repeats with its nation's national team (`exe::database_get_national_team` with `club::NATION`: the under-21 side reaches the senior one). \n Null club (at the start or coming from `exe::database_get_national_team`): the original with null ("Error" box and 0).

The name of `club` in English: its own name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([`G_DATABASE_NAMES_LANGUAGE`]) 0 or 1: its own name (+4). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([`G_ENGLISH_NAME_TABLES`], 79-byte rows from `english_name_tables::CLUB_ROWS`): through the id map [`G_CLUB_ENGLISH_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`] if present, otherwise by id if < the count (+0), otherwise 0.

Adds `delta` (signed byte) to the morale (`player_morale()`) of the player record (person `player()`), damped near the ends; returns whether it changed. \n Going up above 10, if random(21) (`exe::utils_random`) < morale + delta, adds only random(delta + 1); going down below 10, if random((player `player_sheet::LEADERSHIP` + person `staff::PRESSURE` + person `staff::DETERMINATION`) / 3) > morale + delta, adds random(delta − 1). Clamps to 1..20 (signed byte); with `limitar` and delta > 0, the link with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`, person `club_job()`) with `contract::GRIEVANCES` not null prevents going up. Returns 1 if the morale changed. Delta 0: 0, without reading anything.

Widens (movsx) the attributes of `not_player` (coaching attributes +0x0e..+0x22) into the low 16 bits of the 21 three-byte cells of `array` (the 3rd byte of each stays as it is) and writes 13 (the split) into `end` if not null. \n The person is not used. eax on exit: the high 16 bits of the non-player pointer and the last widened attribute (callers do not use it).

Sets `squad` (byte) in the person's squad flags (`staff::PLAYING_SQUAD`): with club bits (& 3) keeps the national team ones (& 0xc), otherwise keeps the club ones; then adds. \n The original writes twice (the mask and the result). Returns the person (eax).

Widens the bytes of the `player` record into a vector of 63 three-byte cells (signed word + weight). \n Zeroes the 63 weights; cells 0..53 by the table `ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_CELLS` (positions 0..8, sides 9..11, then the attributes, weight 2 on those that count and 1 on +0x2a); cell 54 is `determination()` (+0x58) of `person`. The group ends go to the non-null outputs: positions 9, sides 0xc, weighted 0x20. Returns the vector (eax).

1 if the link (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) of `person` with `club` is transfer listed at request (link `transfer_status()`, bit 8). \n Without a club, the contract's club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract` on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], stored in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]; contract `club()` = id in table [`G_CLUB_TABLE`], 581 bytes per club).

1 if `club` may have a reserve side. \n Not: national teams (id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − [`G_NATION_COUNT`]), clubs with an A/B partner (`FN_CLUB_GET_LINKED_B_TEAM` with null and 1); in the range of the second national sides (id ≥ [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] − 2 × [`G_NATION_COUNT`]), nation Spain, Norway, [`KEY_NATION_ITALY`], Brazil or Argentina, or continent (`continent()`) [`KEY_CONTINENT_OCEANIA`] or [`KEY_CONTINENT_AFRICA`]; in the others, nation Spain, Germany or Portugal. Null club: "Error" box and 0 (the original).

How far `who_ve` (the viewer) stands from `person`, which picks the reputation. \n 0 = same club or clubs of the same nation (`club_job()`, club `nation()`) → the home one; 2 = same nation (`nation()`) or not foreign in it (`exe::database_is_staff_foreign`) → the current one; 3 = not foreign in the nation of the person's club, or player reputation (`player()`, +9) + reputation of the viewer's club (`reputation()`) ≥ 14000 → the average; 4 (no viewer, viewer among the last 16 ids (id ≥ [`G_STAFF_COUNT`] − 16) = human managers, no data or no club) → the world one. \n Only al is returned (callers use al).

The reputation of `person` as seen by `who_ve`, by the scope (`exe::database_get_reputation_scope`): from the player data (`player()`: current +9, home +0xb, world +0xd) or, with `not_player`, from the non-player data (`non_player()`: +8, +0xa, +0xc). \n 4 → world, 2 → current, 0 → home, 3 → half the world + half the current, other → half the home + half the current (truncating divisions). Only ax is returned.

1 if `person` is foreign in `nation` (null: 1). \n Not foreign with the nation as first (`nation()`) or second nationality (`second_nation()`). With `groups`, also not foreign: among England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and Ireland (British Isles); between Australia and [`KEY_NATION_NEW_ZEALAND`]; in [`KEY_NATION_ITALY`] with the nation [`KEY_NATION_UKRAINE`]; and in Portugal someone who is not from the EU (`exe::database_is_staff_eu_national`) with a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract` on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`]) that started up to 1/1/1998 (Date `exe::date_date_549f70`; contract `date_started()` day, `date_started_year()` year).

The age of `person` in whole years on `data` (word +0 day of year, +2 year): year − birth year (`date_of_birth_year()`), minus 1 if the birth day (`date_of_birth()`) has not come yet. \n Null person: "Error" box and 0xff (the original). Only ax is returned (callers use al).

1 if `person` counts as an EU national for a club of `nation_of_club`. \n Nationality (`nation()`) or second nationality (`second_nation()`) with the EU mark (nation `group_membership()` = `nation_group::EEC`) or Switzerland ([`KEY_NATION_SWITZERLAND`]); in Germany, any European (nation `continent()` = the continent [`KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE`] in table [`G_CONTINENT_TABLE`], 198 bytes); in [`KEY_NATION_ITALY`], everyone; in Denmark, [`KEY_NATION_ICELAND`], Norway and [`KEY_NATION_LIECHTENSTEIN`].

1 if the link (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) of `person` with `club` is transfer listed, by the club or at request (link `transfer_status()`, bits 1 and 8). \n Without a club, the contract's club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract` on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], stored in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]; contract `club()` = club id in table [`G_CLUB_TABLE`], 581 bytes per club).

The player `attribute` (1..31) as 1 to 20. \n Some are the byte of the `player` record; the relative ones give the rating (`attribute_rating`) of 2 × byte + current ability (+5), or of 2 × byte + ability × 0.1 (`rdata::F64_0_1`) depending on the goalkeeper (`player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`: = 20 or < 15); 10 is `determination()` (+0x58) of `person`; some go to `exe::player_attribute_rating` (or `exe::player_attribute_rating_with_scaled_ability`). No person, no player or attribute out of range: "Error" box and 0xff (the original). Only al is returned.
reads global `G_DATABASE_NAMES_LANGUAGE`

Refuses a loan with five loans this season (0x1e) and between clubs of the same division (0x1d). \n `IRELAND_RULES::can_loan_player(club, player, message, reason)`: five loans in the season (the 16-byte count at [[`G_TRANSFER_MANAGER`] + `transfer_manager_fields::SEASON_LOAN_COUNTS`]): 0x1e; with a contract (`loan_owner_club`), the requesting club and the owner in the same division (`division()`, without checking for null, as in the original): 0x1d, with the nation's name (`refuse_loan`).

Returns the Scottish loan period: it starts next month; under 22 it ends in the season end exe::date_get_month(this year or next), otherwise three months later. \n `SCOTLAND_RULES::get_loan_period(a1, a2, start_month, start_year, end_month, end_year, player)`: it starts in the following month; the end is the season end month of nation a1 (`exe::contract_manager_season_end_month` on [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`]) for those under 22 (`age()`), this year if the start comes before it, otherwise the following year; for the others, three months after the start.

Constructs the Scottish transfer rules (rule 21): one window, from 30 May (moved to the Saturday [inference]) to 30 March (moved to the Thursday [inference]); dword `transfer_rules::SKIP_CONTRACT_TYPE_5_INELIGIBILITY` = 1. \n `SCOTLAND_RULES::SCOTLAND_RULES`; SEH frame only for the `new`, no destructor on the normal path. The Scotland transfer rules (rule 21): the base (`exe::new_transfer_rules`, through `construct_nation_rules`), the vtable 0x96f838, 1 window from `SCOTLAND_TRANSFER_WINDOWS` and dword `transfer_rules::SKIP_CONTRACT_TYPE_5_INELIGIBILITY` = 1. Returns the object.

Turns each folder file matching the pattern (FindFirstFile) into a container item: zopen for writing, fread/zwrite in 0x30d40-byte blocks, zclose. \n `zadd_matching_files(path, folder, pattern, a4, kind)`: each file in the folder that `FindFirstFile` finds with the pattern (`exe::file_find_first`/`exe::file_find_next`, files only, in the system's order) becomes a container item: `zopen` for writing (`exe::zopen`, creates the container with `a4`/`kind` if it does not exist) + `fread` (`exe::crt_fread`) in blocks of 0x30d40 into the item's read buffer (`zfile::READ_BUFFER`) + `zwrite` (`exe::zwrite`) + `zclose` (`exe::zclose`). 1 at the end; 0 if nothing matches. A file that does not open or an item refused: the error box (zipdir.cpp 797 / 805) and 0, without closing the search (as the original).

Turns each container item whose name matches the pattern into a folder file (zopen for reading, zread in 0x30d40-byte blocks, fwrite). \n `zextract_matching_files(path, folder, pattern)`: copies the names of the index's 1000 slots (the empty ones as "{ Empty }") into a list of 0x104 bytes per name (malloc `exe::crt_malloc`); each name that matches the pattern (`exe::zipdir_match_filename_pattern`) and opens (`exe::zopen` reading, a4 0x15, kind 4) becomes a file in the folder ("wb"), in blocks of 0x30d40 read by `zread` (`exe::zread`) into the item's write buffer (`zfile::WRITE_BUFFER`). 1 if it extracted any. A file that cannot be created: 0 (closes the item). \n Stack garbage in the original: on the error paths (out of memory for the list, a container that does not open or is of an unknown type) it closes the item from a local variable that was never written; here it starts at 0. Out of memory for the index, the error box (zipdir.cpp 642) writes the name "zipdir" over the answer (the same stack slot) and the list carries on without the names (memory from the allocation).

Writes to the item like fwrite and adds to the size in the index; on type 4 encodes the RLE (runs of up to 0x7f kept across calls). \n `zwrite(buf, size, count, z)` like `fwrite`, in the item opened for writing (otherwise 0): adds `size × how_many` to the item's size in the index and to the logical position. Type 3: a direct `fwrite` (`exe::crt_fwrite`, returns whatever it returns). Type 4: encodes the RLE byte by byte, keeping the run in `zfile::RLE_REPEAT_BYTE`/+0x14 between calls; a different byte closes the run (1 with byte <= 0x80 goes out as a literal, otherwise the pair 0x80 + n, byte); at 0x7f the pair goes out and the run restarts. Returns `how_many`.
